scope: frontend login success path and stale auth-check isolation

checks.evidence: LoginForm calls AuthProvider.login; AuthProvider.login calls loginRequest; loginRequest posts to /auth/login and does not call sessionCheckRequest or /auth/me.
AuthProvider uses sessionCheckGenerationRef. Starting login invalidates in-flight session checks, and stale /auth/me completions or aborts return without changing auth state.
The login path imports AuthProvider and auth API only; it does not import capability-state-provider or capability bootstrap APIs.
The login path does not import module-access-provider, adapter-access-provider, module registry APIs, or execution provider APIs.
LoginForm aborts and resolves the loading state after 5000ms, showing a retryable error instead of a permanent spinner.

verification.details: Only sessionCheckRequest in frontend/src/lib/auth.ts references /auth/me; the login chain does not call it.
